title: Home Protection Plans Monthly Fee Billing Rules
content:
Billing operations rules for the monthly fee of every Home Protection Plan.

## Rules

**B1. Months billed.** The monthly fee is billed for every month starting with the month of the enrollment date, including months of the waiting period, through the month of cancellation. Each billed month is one monthly fee line on the plan, dated by the first day of the month billed.

**B2. Billable status.** Plan fees are billed only while the plan is in waiting period or active, as shown by the plan's status on the company's plan record when the fee line is posted.

**B3. Amount.** The fee billed is the plan's monthly fee. It cannot change during the plan's price lock period, counted in months from enrollment; any later change requires the plan's notice period, in calendar days, before the change.

**B4. Where the fee appears.** A plan billed on the energy bill appears on the bill of the Beacon Ridge agreement named to carry the fee; a plan billed by direct invoice appears on its own invoice.

## Status and billing

| Plan status | Monthly fee billed |
|---|---|
| Waiting period | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Cancelled | No |

## Examples (hypothetical dates)

1. Enrolled 20 January, cancelled 3 April. The months billed are January, February, March and April: four monthly fee lines.
2. Enrolled 28 June with a 30-day waiting period, so coverage starts in July. June is billed even though the whole of June falls within the waiting period.
3. A plan billed on the Beacon Ridge electricity bill of the premise shows its fee on that agreement's bill; the same plan moved to direct invoicing shows the fee on its own invoice.
